question: Would this bother you, or someone else using the site?

items.what: Fees only in percent, nothing in shekels, so 0.56 vs 0.67 says nothing to me
When I switched to עצמאים, the fields moved around and changed places (the return field jumped up next to the deposit).
items.where: the calculator fields after picking עצמאים

items.what: Part of the screen jumped sideways when I typed the first number.
items.where: Input row after filling סכום היום

items.what: 16 tracks that look almost the same, with no recommendation. It makes me want to do nothing.
Turquoise and yellow circles that look almost the same
The first big number (74,044 ₪) assumes 5% a year on a current account, so it looks like my עו"ש grows nicely. That's the opposite of the point.
Clicking the tab scrolled the page by itself, a long way down.
Codes like MF-16 and BANK-18 everywhere mean nothing to me and clutter the screen
Codes like TXI OQ11, BANK-20 mean nothing to me
items.where: שווה לדעת, מה האתר לקח בחשבון

items.what: The tax paragraph with 69,840 / 10,920 figures is dense and hard to follow
The guide is a long wall of more than 25 similar cards with no beginner's starting point, which is overwhelming
The cost of breaking a deposit is never given in shekels, only 'לפי התעריפון' and 'שאלה פתוחה'
items.where: כמה זה עולה table and red box in מיסוי

items.what: The red tag 'מס רווח במכירה' on foreign funds scares me off without saying how much
Second fee '1.47% מההפקדות' looks big and isn't explained in words I understand

note: v0: a seeded random draw of 12 from the 544 first-10 findings of runs/baseline-1/reviewer (draw.json); moving-browser: findings the movement instruction added on clean pages in browser mode (runs/candidate-moving/with). The founder sees only page, device, words and where, in this order.
